text.p: French carmaker Renault SA said it had decided to sell its 0.9 percent stake in Elf Aquitaine and added that the oil group was buying the shares.
Renault obtained 2.5 million Elf shares on February 22, 1994, at Elf's privatisation. Renault, a state company at the time, was part of the core shareholding group of Elf.

At the time of the privatisation, institutions paid 403 francs per share for Elf stock. On Wednesday, Elf closed at 598 francs, which would indicate a capital gain for Renault of some 487 million francs.

In a separate statement, Elf said that its subsidiary Financiere Valorgest was ready to buy the block of shares. The other core shareholders of Elf have until June 3 to use their pre-emption right to buy the shares, it added.
